title: The corner box
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: The digest's weekly cover. The logging road. In the corner, an ad from a syndicate that doesn't exist: COMING 2003 · SLASH.

panels.composition: The laundromat digest's cover, quarter-letter. A landscape: a logging road after rain, potholes full of white sky, ruts, a gate, the spruce closing over it. No figure. In the bottom-left corner, boxed, hand-lettered in the strip's own display face as if it were a syndicate ad: COMING 2003 · A GRAPHIC NOVEL BY A. FINCH · 'SLASH' · A crime story of the Oregon coast.
panels.caption: COMING 2003 · A GRAPHIC NOVEL BY A. FINCH · "SLASH" · A crime story of the Oregon coast.

image.prompt: a small zine cover drawing: a wet logging road after rain with potholes reflecting a white sky, deep ruts, a closed gate, dark spruce closing overhead, no people, brush-pen black and white with xerox grain, and a small boxed advertisement hand-lettered in the lower left corner
image.notes: The box text is the point; letter it after if it garbles. The first of three corner boxes (2002, 2008, 2016). Nothing ever comes.

art.line: brush-pen, committed; xerox; black and white

notes: The first corner box. The strip never refers to it.
